records.name: AbleMouse Beyond Switch Edition
records.tagline: Full PC control for the paralyzed via one micro-movement.
records.description: An open-source solution designed for individuals with extreme physical limitations, including total paralysis. The system enables voice commands for non-verbal users and bypasses OS language barriers. Ready to restore digital independence. 🦾

records.name: Doclific
records.tagline: Documentation that lives with your code
records.description: Most documentation tools live outside your repository. Your code changes. Your docs don’t. Drift is inevitable. Doclific addresses this problem in two ways: 1. Your docs all live in one place: your repo. This is the way it should be, ensuring engineers always have access to the correct version of docs. 2. Doclific features ERDs, architecture diagrams, smart snippets, etc. No more context switching. No more drift. Oh, and if you're lazy, you can just prompt the AI to generate docs for you!

When your app changes, you don’t fix broken tests. You re-record the flow and keep your coverage up to date. With QAI you can focus on building features and go live with confidence.
